note: Chapter 8 from docs/chapter-08/CHAPTER_08_PRODUCTION.md. Human lines are overheard.

keeper.name: The man in the grey coat

lantern_path.speaker: narrator
lantern_path.text: A lantern on a post, burning with moonlight. Behind it, a path that shouldn't be there.

lantern_path.speaker: galen
lantern_path.text: The Oathkeepers' road. It runs between places that are close in the other world. Bandar Senja is close tonight.

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: Three nights pass in three steps. The Lantern Moon rises, huge and gold, over the old railway town.

C8_01_hub.speaker: narrator
C8_01_hub.text: Bandar Senja, on the night of the Lantern Moon. The streetlamps flicker. In three places, the air has split like old paper, and the other world is leaking through.

C8_01_hub.speaker: elias
C8_01_hub.text: Three tears. West by the river, east in the night market, and something stirring on the old railway.

C8_01_hub.speaker: galen
C8_01_hub.text: If they open all the way, the worlds will touch. Things will be lost. People will be lost.

C8_01_hub.speaker: reno
C8_01_hub.text: Then we split up! Like a heist! Lumi takes the river with Maris and Elias. I'll take the market with Taro and Galen.

C8_01_hub.speaker: narrator
C8_01_hub.text: New goal: seal the river tear (west) and the market tear (east). Walk into a tear to send a team.

human_stationmaster.speaker: stationmaster
human_stationmaster.text: (to himself) The signal lamps keep going green on their own. Like a train's coming. No train's come down that line since '51.

human_moon_girl.speaker: moon_girl
human_moon_girl.text: Mak! Mak, the moon has a door in it! ...She can't hear me. Nobody ever believes me about the moon.

lm_sprites_beaten.speaker: narrator
lm_sprites_beaten.text: The sprites fizzle back through the cracks.

tear_sealed.speaker: narrator
tear_sealed.text: Just a faint line in the air, like a healed scratch.

C8_02_river_go.speaker: narrator
C8_02_river_go.text: The river tear. Cold water pours out of nothing and runs down the street.

then.speaker: reno
then.text: YOU be careful. I'm always careful.

C8_03_market_go.speaker: narrator
C8_03_market_go.text: The market tear. Lantern light spills out of it like honey, and something inside is chewing.

then.speaker: taro
then.text: A night market! My natural habitat.

C8_04_railway_go.speaker: narrator
C8_04_railway_go.text: The railway tear. Through it: a platform at night, a crowd, and a train that's about to not stop.

C8_04_railway_go.speaker: elias
C8_04_railway_go.text: This one's different. It's pulling at the token on Reno's belt.

C8_04_railway_go.speaker: galen
C8_04_railway_go.text: Then it's for the two of you. We'll hold the street.

archive_door_shut.speaker: narrator
archive_door_shut.text: The tear has closed into the shape of a door. It won't open. Not yet.

C8_02_arrive.speaker: narrator
C8_02_arrive.text: The river tear. A street of shophouses, knee-deep in spirit water. Paper boats bump against doorsteps.

C8_02_arrive.speaker: maris
C8_02_arrive.text: The water's coming from the far side. We need a way across.

C8_02_arrive.speaker: elias
C8_02_arrive.text: And then we find the knot holding it open.

C8_02_regrow.speaker: narrator
C8_02_regrow.text: Maris kneels by the water. Vines wind out from the cracks in the road and knot themselves into a bridge.

C8_02_echo.speaker: narrator
C8_02_echo.text: Lumi looks with Echo Sight. The water is all pulling towards one spot, like a drain: a knot in the air, glowing.

C8_02_echo.speaker: lumi
C8_02_echo.text: There. Something's holding the tear open from inside.

C8_02_wraith_intro.speaker: narrator
C8_02_wraith_intro.text: The knot unravels into a wraith of river water, wearing a hundred lost things: sandals, a fishing hat, a school bag.

C8_02_river_sealed.speaker: narrator
C8_02_river_sealed.text: The wraith sinks back into the tear. Elias tunes himself to the tear's hum, finds the right note, and holds it until the edges meet.

C8_02_river_sealed.speaker: elias
C8_02_river_sealed.text: Sealed. Like closing a radio channel.

C8_02_river_sealed.speaker: narrator
C8_02_river_sealed.text: Two tears sealed. In the old railway yard, the last one opens.

C8_03_arrive.speaker: narrator
C8_03_arrive.text: The market tear. Ghostly stalls float half in, half out of the ordinary night market. At the far end, a silent stone blocks the alley.

C8_03_arrive.speaker: galen
C8_03_arrive.text: He's been here too. That stone.

C8_03_arrive.speaker: taro
C8_03_arrive.text: And there's a human standing right in front of it.

C8_03_watchman.speaker: watchman
C8_03_watchman.text: (muttering) Something's in that alley. I can feel it. I'm not moving till I know what.

C8_03_watchman.speaker: taro
C8_03_watchman.text: If the tear opens wider, it'll swallow him. Tonight even humans can see a really good illusion. Want me to make a Decoy?

then.speaker: narrator
then.text: Taro folds the air into a paper cat. It meows, very convincingly, and trots away down the street. The watchman, astonished, follows it: "Oi! Puss!"

then.speaker: taro
then.text: Hmm. He's not going anywhere on his own.

C8_03_stone_wait.speaker: galen
C8_03_stone_wait.text: I can break it. Not with a human standing so close. The tear would take him.

C8_03_break.speaker: narrator
C8_03_break.text: Galen puts his shoulder to the silent stone. It cracks in half. Behind it, something enormous is eating the lantern light.

C8_03_glutton_intro.speaker: narrator
C8_03_glutton_intro.text: A lantern spirit the size of a lorry, swollen with stolen light, turns around with its mouth full.

C8_03_glutton_intro.speaker: reno
C8_03_glutton_intro.text: Excuse me! That's the market's light!

C8_03_market_sealed.speaker: narrator
C8_03_market_sealed.text: The Glutton coughs up a hundred lanterns, which float back to their stalls. It shrinks to the size of a teacup and scuttles into the tear, which snaps shut behind it.

C8_03_market_sealed.speaker: taro
C8_03_market_sealed.text: I said ta-da on everyone's behalf.

C8_03_market_sealed.speaker: narrator
C8_03_market_sealed.text: Two tears sealed. In the old railway yard, the last one opens.

C8_04_arrive.speaker: narrator
C8_04_arrive.text: The railway tear. It isn't now. It's 1951: a platform crowded with people, rain, a train that won't stop, and the gap between the worlds wide open beneath it.

C8_04_arrive.speaker: narrator
C8_04_arrive.text: Through the crowd, two figures are pulling people back from the edge. A railway worker with a lantern, and a guardian spirit made of soft light.

C8_04_arrive.speaker: lumi
C8_04_arrive.text: ...Reno. That spirit. I know her. I don't know how, but I know her.

C8_04_arrive.speaker: reno
C8_04_arrive.text: The railway lady has a token. Lumi, it's MY token. The same one.

C8_04_arrive.speaker: narrator
C8_04_arrive.text: The echo of that night gathers itself into something that can fight.

C8_04_echo_intro.speaker: narrator
C8_04_echo_intro.text: The Echo of 1951 rises off the rails: smoke, rain and a whistle that never stops.

C8_04_echo_intro.speaker: lumi
C8_04_echo_intro.text: We can't change what happened. But we can stop it happening again.

C8_04_keeper.speaker: narrator
C8_04_keeper.text: The echo fades. The rain stops. The platform is empty except for one man in a grey coat, with ink on his fingers.

C8_04_keeper.speaker: keeper
C8_04_keeper.text: You held them. All three. I didn't think anyone could.

C8_04_keeper.speaker: reno
C8_04_keeper.text: YOU. You made everyone forget! You put mist on a mountain! You were mean to a TREE!

C8_04_keeper.speaker: keeper
C8_04_keeper.text: I made them forget so it would hurt less. In 1951 I stood on this platform and I couldn't hold the crossing. Two people held it instead. A railway worker named Maya, and a guardian named Seri. They didn't come back.

C8_04_keeper.speaker: keeper
C8_04_keeper.text: The Promise says the worlds should touch. Every time they touch, someone is lost. So I will close them. For good. They call me the Keeper now. The Keeper of Silence.

C8_04_keeper.speaker: keeper
C8_04_keeper.text: If you want to stop me, you'll need to know the whole truth. It's in the Archive. I doubt you'll like it.

C8_04_keeper.speaker: narrator
C8_04_keeper.text: He steps backwards into the air and is gone. Something falls where he stood.

C8_04_keeper.speaker: narrator
C8_04_keeper.text: Got the Ticket to Nowhere and the Lantern Moon Charm (Lumi: MAG +3, RES +2).

C8_04_keeper.speaker: lumi
C8_04_keeper.text: And I think I came from Seri. Somehow.

C8_04_keeper.speaker: narrator
C8_04_keeper.text: Back in the street, the others are waiting. Nobody says anything for a while. Then Taro hands out toffee apples, and that helps.
